title: VIN appears as an extra block line only when the VIN toggle is on, in day and week views only (month omits it)
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on a desktop browser.
2. A shift exists for a unit that has a VIN.
3. You are on the Schedule page; the VIN toggle in 'Filter and Display' is OFF.
custom_steps:
1. In week view, read the shift block (VIN off).
2. Turn the VIN toggle ON in 'Filter and Display'.
3. Read the block again in week view, then in day view, then in month view.
custom_expected:
1. VIN off: the block shows three lines, no VIN.
2. VIN on: a VIN line is added to the block in week view and day view.
3. Month view still omits the VIN line even with the toggle on (space constraints).
